response.overview: # The Story of Rafiq, an Instagram celebrity who was making a viral video about 'What does it mean to be 21', has been arrested for the offense of receiving prohibited substances in a nightclub. As a popular college student, Rafiq has been suspended from college for a semester to restore the college's reputation and ease the situation at that time. Mansor and Lia, who are Rafiq's parents, are upset about the matter. As a father who is also a celebrity and busy earning a living for his family, Mansor places all the blame on Lia, who is also an influential motivator, for failing to monitor their child's activities. After much thought, Lia finally suggests that Rafiq be sent back to her husband's village to spend his college suspension leave. Mansor, who still harbors resentment toward his mother, Mak Timah Andam, regarding the separation of his parents when he was young, initially refuses.
response.title: Nenek Aku Instafamous
